item.text: `Roles.Equals` compares list lengths and then checks one-way membership, which can miss a distinct-role difference when duplicates are present. I’ll compare distinct-role sets in both directions. `Roles.Check` already calls `Role.Check`; I’ll add a duplicate check and extend the existing role tests to cover these cases.
